name: audio-stem-lab
description: Separate one actual MP3/WAV music clip up to 120 seconds and 20 MB into selected vocal and instrument estimates. Choose WAV or MP3, then play and download each returned stem separately. Supports vocals, drums, bass, other, guitar and piano; absence of a returned file is reported. Bleed and missing detail may occur. Does not create music or grant rights. Requires a connected account. NebulaCafe and its providers process audio; public links are accessible to anyone holding them.

review.commerce_description: Requires a connected Firemoon account with sufficient processing balance. Processing is billed by Firemoon. Purchases take place on the Firemoon website. The plugin does not execute money transfers, crypto transfers or investment trades.

publication.release_notes: Update public branding and listing links to NebulaCafe. Reviewer scenarios include the complete request and actual required inputs. The verified production MCP connection URL remains unchanged.
